description: This file defines functions for filtering and postprocessing autocomplete suggestions, including duplication detection, normalization, and integration with external postprocessing pipelines.

methods.name: suggestionConsideredDuplication
methods.description: Determines if an autocomplete suggestion is a duplicate based on prefix, suffix, and content repetition.

methods.name: DuplicatesFromPrefixOrSuffix
methods.description: Checks if the suggestion is duplicated at the prefix or suffix edges.

methods.name: DuplicatesFromEdgeLines
methods.description: Checks for duplication across the edges of multiline suggestions.

methods.name: containsRepetitivePhraseFromPrefix
methods.description: Detects if the suggestion contains a repetitive phrase indicating a loop.

methods.name: normalizeToCompleteLine
methods.description: Expands partial suggestions to full lines for better duplication detection.

methods.name: postprocessGhostSuggestion
methods.description: Postprocesses suggestions by applying external postprocessing and duplicate filtering.
